module.name: no-await-in-loop
module.description: Review repeated waits inside loops and allow intentional sequential work.

scenarios.name: should allow nested loops within an opted-in async iterator body
scenarios.given: async function run() { for await (const item of stream) { while (more) { await work(); } } }
scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with options [{ allowForAwaitOf: true }]
scenarios.then: no diagnostic is reported

scenarios.name: should allow asserted awaits outside loops
scenarios.given: async function run() { await (work() as Promise<void>); }
scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with default options
scenarios.then: no diagnostic is reported

scenarios.name: should allow optional calls in configured retry

scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with options [{ allowedFunctionNames: ['retry'] }]
scenarios.then: no diagnostic is reported
